title: Quick Add Intel
description:
Creates intel by providing minimal details of indicators, SDOs, relations, custom objects, and indicators parsed from free text.

> [!NOTE]
> Default Source: Import
> Default Collection: Free Text

**Note**: At least one of the `indicators`, `sdos`, `observables`, or `custom_objects` is required to create an intel.

The indicators object in Quick Add Intel accepts the IOC type as the key and a comma-separated list of IOC values as the value. You can pass a maximum of 5000 characters as the IOC value per IOC type.
For the allowed list of IOC types and the respective key to pass in the indicators object, refer to the following table:

The custom_objects object in Quick Add Intel accepts the ID of a custom object as the key and a list of custom attribute objects as the value.
The custom attribute object accepts the name of the primary attribute of a custom object as the key and the attribute value as the value.
To retrieve the custom object IDs and the respective primary attribute, use the GET Custom Object Details API in Administration > Custom Entities Management > Custom Objects.
The sdos object in Quick Add Intel accepts the STIX Domain Object (SDO) type as the key and a comma-separated list of SDO values as the value. You can pass a maximum of 5000 characters as the SDO value per SDO type.

body.name: parsed_indicators
body.description: Pass the IOC types and indicators parsed from free text. For more information, see *The Parse Indicators Object*.

body.name: metadata
body.description: Pass the additional information to add to the intel.

items.name: tlp
items.description: Pass the TLP value for the intel.

items.name: is_apply_all
items.description: Pass true to apply the metadata to all intel objects. Else, pass false to apply the metadata to the report object that is created as part of the quick add intel submission only.

items.name: custom_scores
items.description: Pass the custom score key and the score in key-value pairs.

items.name: confidence
items.description: Pass a Source Confidence Score for the intel between 0 and 100.

items.name: labels
items.description: Pass a list of tag IDs to add to the intel. To retrieve the list of tags, use the **List Tags** API in the **Tags** section.

items.name: description
items.description: Pass a description for the intel within 1000 characters.

body.name: indicators
body.description: Pass the IOC types and IOC values in key-value pairs. For more information, see *The Indicators Object*.

items.name: ipv4-addr
items.description: Pass the value for the IOC type.

body.name: title
body.description: Pass a title for the intel within 100 characters. The title is added to the report object that is created as part of the quick add intel submission.

body.name: sdos
body.description: Pass the SDO types and comma-separated SDO values. For more information, see *The SDOs Object*.

items.name: vulnerability
items.description: Pass the SDO value for the SDO type.

body.name: observables
body.description: Pass the STIX Cyber Observable Object (SCO) types and comma-separated SCO values. For more information, see *The Observables Object*.

body.name: relations
body.description:
Pass the objects to be associated with the report object created as part of this Quick Add submission.
The following object types are not supported for adding as relations: 
Domain Objects: Observed Data, Opinion, Report, Note, Custom Object, and Location
Observables: Network Traffic and X.509 Certificate
Indicators: MD5, SHA1, SHA224, SHA384, SHA256, SHA512, and SSDEEP

items.name: name
items.description: Pass the name of the object.

items.name: type
items.description: Pass the type of the object.

items.name: ioc_type
items.description: Pass the IOC type of the object.

items.name: id
items.description: Pass the ID of the object.

body.name: custom_objects
body.description: Pass the ID of the custom objects and the corresponding custom attributes. For more information, see *The Custom Objects Object*.

items.name: 7e081615-a44b-4d52-bd8d-48b9bbbd37a8
items.description: Pass the ID of the custom object.

items.name: action
items.description: Pass the action of the custom object.

body.name: create_intel_feed
body.description: Pass true to create an intel feed. Else, pass false to create a draft intel.

body.name: details
body.description: Returns that the details are successfully added to the intel creation queue.
body.value: You will be notified once the STIX is created

body.name: task_id
body.description: Returns the unique ID of the background task that is created to track the intel creation status.
